jobs.title: AI Software Engineer
jobs.description: Requires 3+ years of experience. Must meet at least one: 3+ years of professional Software Engineering experience in production environments OR a B.Sc. in Computer Science/Software Engineering/Mathematics/Physics OR relevant backend/AI software development experience from an elite military technology unit. Hands-on experience developing LLM-powered features/applications, including prompt engineering and RAG architectures. Strong proficiency in Python, TypeScript/JavaScript, Java, or another major language, with hands-on experience building REST APIs, database modeling, and complex integrations.

jobs.title: Network & Security Engineer
jobs.description: Requires 3+ years of experience. 3+ years of hands-on networking experience in a large-scale enterprise environment Strong hands-on knowledge of routing and switching technologies and network protocols Hands-on experience with Cisco Nexus and Cisco Catalyst

jobs.title: DevOps & CloudOps
jobs.description: Requires 5+ years of experience. 5+ years of experience building CI/CD processes using Jenkins, Azure Pipelines, or similar tools Hands-on experience managing cloud infrastructure with Azure and AWS Advanced scripting skills in Bash, Python, or Groovy

jobs.title: Mainframe DBA
jobs.description: Requires 5+ years of experience. 5+ years of hands-on experience as a DB2 DBA Proven experience working with DB2 in a z/OS / mainframe environment Strong SQL knowledge and experience with DB2 utilities
